name: ذاكرة التسلسل
tagline: شاهد واستمع وكرّر. ما طول التسلسل الذي تتذكره؟
description: العب ذاكرة التسلسل مجانًا: كرّر تسلسلًا متزايدًا من الأضواء والأصوات على أربع لوحات. حطّم رقمك أو تسابق مع أصدقائك عبر الإنترنت.
about: Sequence Memory is a game of watching, listening and remembering. Four pads sit in a square, each with its own colour, shape and sound. The game lights one pad; you press it. Then it lights two in a row, and you press both, in the same order. Each time you get it right, the sequence grows by one more step.

It gets hard quickly: most people manage seven or eight steps, and the sequences play a little faster as they grow. One wrong pad ends the game, and the game shows you which pad it should have been. Your score is the longest sequence you repeated.

You can follow the sequence by sight, by sound or both, since every pad has a different note and a different shape as well as a colour. Race friends online and everyone gets the very same sequence: who remembers the most?
howToPlay: Press Start. Watch the pads: the game lights them one at a time, each with its sound.
When it says it's your turn, press the pads in the same order.
Get it right and the sequence plays again with one more step at the end.
One wrong pad ends the game. Your score is the longest sequence you repeated.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap the pads.
Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 and 4 press the pads, numbered in their corners.
Pause or start again from the bar above the game. Pausing replays the sequence when you return.
tips: Say the sequence to yourself as it plays: “circle, square, square, diamond.”
Group the steps in threes or fours, like a phone number.
Listen as well as look: each pad's sound is different, and tunes are easy to remember.
The sequence only ever adds one step at the end, so you just need to remember the newest one.
Take your time on your turn: there's no clock while you press.

faq.question: Is Sequence Memory free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: What is a good score?
faq.answer: Seven or eight is typical. Twelve and up is a strong memory; past twenty is rare.

faq.question: Is there a time limit on my turn?
faq.answer: No. Take as long as you need to press each pad. Only the playback gets faster as the sequence grows.

faq.question: Can I play without colour or sound?
faq.answer: Yes: every pad has a different shape and position as well as a colour and a sound, so any one of them is enough to follow.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same sequence. The longest one repeated wins.

ui.over: انتهت اللعبة: كرّرت {n} خطوة. اللوحة المضيئة كانت التالية.
